articles.title: Imran Khan Receives October 28 Deadline to Leave India After Joining Mumbai’s CJP Protest
articles.description: Actor Imran Khan has been asked to leave India by October 28, 2026, following his participation in the Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) protest at Mumbai’s August Kranti Maidan. The Foreigners Regional Registration Office (FRRO), Mumbai, reportedly issued the notice after BJP leader Kirit Somaiya filed a complaint alleging violations of OCI provisions and visa conditions. Imran, an American citizen who holds an OCI card, was detained during the October 10 protest and later released. The controversy comes as the actor prepares for his Bollywood comeback with Netflix’s Adhure Hum Adhure Tum.

articles.title: France aims to host 30,000 Indian students by 2030, says deputy envoy Amon

Initiatives like the Choose France Tour help Indian students connect with French institutions and clarify academic options. French higher education institutions are also focusing on attracting more Indian students through English-taught programs.
